items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: I had a cousin, she was trying to play in the girl band. Her name was Leliska at the time. I was about seventeen then at the time. And she gave me an old trumpet and I just began to play by ear.

ctx.x: Your father or mother didn't play or sing anything much? No, they played at all.

None of them did any musical, not at all. I just, you know, I liked it by hearing bands playing, you know. Yeah. I'd be in the take and take... In other words, I had a cousin, she was trying to play in the girl band. Her name was Leliska at the time. I was about seventeen then at the time. And she gave me an old trumpet and I just began to play by ear. And finally, I heard of a teacher, which was Kid Rene, he's also deceased.
